mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GAME_EVENT (EVENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, TEMPLATE_ID, VAR_VALUE, EFFECT_SCALE, HIST_EVENT_ID, HIST_TYPE_CODE, INTENSITY, TITLE, BASE_TEXT, IS_REVIEWED, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, GENDER, MIN_WEALTH, MAX_WEALTH, REQUIRED_EXP_ID, EXCLUDED_EXP_ID, IS_ONCE, PROBABILITY, IS_CHOICE, AI_NARRATE, EFF_WEALTH_RATE) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{templateId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{varValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{effectScale}, #{histEventId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{histTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{intensity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title}, #{baseText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isReviewed}, #{minAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{maxAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{minWealth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{maxWealth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{requiredExpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{excludedExpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isOnce}, #{probability, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{isChoice}, #{aiNarrate}, #{effWealthRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE GAME_EVENT SET TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VAR_VALUE = #{varValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EFFECT_SCALE = #{effectScale}, HIST_EVENT_ID = #{histEventId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HIST_TYPE_CODE = #{histTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, INTENSITY = #{intensity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TITLE = #{title}, BASE_TEXT = #{baseText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_REVIEWED = #{isReviewed}, MIN_AGE = #{minAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MAX_AGE = #{maxAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GENDER = #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MIN_WEALTH = #{minWealth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MAX_WEALTH = #{maxWealth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, REQUIRED_EXP_ID = #{requiredExpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXCLUDED_EXP_ID = #{excludedExpId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_ONCE = #{isOnce}, PROBABILITY = #{probability, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, IS_CHOICE = #{isChoice}, AI_NARRATE = #{aiNarrate}, EFF_WEALTH_RATE = #{effWealthRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
UPDATE GAME_EVENT SET AI_NARRATE = #{value} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(CHOICE_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM EVENT_CHOICE WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_CHOICE WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND CHOICE_ORDER = #{choiceOrder}
SELECT RESULT_ACTION FROM EVENT_CHOICE WHERE RESULT_ACTION IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT RESULT_ACTION FROM EVENT_TEMPLATE WHERE RESULT_ACTION IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_EVENT_CHOICE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO EVENT_CHOICE (CHOICE_ID, EVENT_ID, CHOICE_ORDER, CHOICE_TEXT, RESULT_TEXT, EFF_HEALTH, EFF_HAPPINESS, EFF_KNOWLEDGE, EFF_RELATION, EFF_INCOME_RATE, EFF_WEALTH_RATE, RESULT_ACTION, MIGRATE_TO, SUCCESS_RATE) VALUES (#{choiceId}, #{eventId}, #{choiceOrder}, #{choiceText}, #{resultText}, #{effHealth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{effHappiness, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{effKnowledge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{effRelation, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{effIncomeRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{effWealthRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{resultAction, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{migrateTo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{successRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENT_CHOICE SET CHOICE_TEXT = #{choiceText}, RESULT_TEXT = #{resultText}, EFF_HEALTH = #{effHealth, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, EFF_HAPPINESS = #{effHappiness, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, EFF_KNOWLEDGE = #{effKnowledge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, EFF_RELATION = #{effRelation, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, EFF_INCOME_RATE = #{effIncomeRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, EFF_WEALTH_RATE = #{effWealthRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, RESULT_ACTION = #{resultAction, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MIGRATE_TO = #{migrateTo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SUCCESS_RATE = #{successRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE CHOICE_ID = #{choiceId}
UPDATE GAME_EVENT SET BASE_TEXT = #{baseText}, IS_REVIEWED = 'Y' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND EVENT_TYPE = 'HIST'
